name: Urugugu Canyon reward table, 2026-11-11 17:29:18 (the frame 0.10.53 kept as -reward-table, its first read): 27 slots (8, 8, 8, 3) over the planked floor. 0.10.53 read this table as 34 and 39 slots (Steven: "credit for a shit ton of loot ... like gold bows"): the table slid in after its header, the first row was looked for only 3 px under the header's estimate, and a box of planks past the row of three stood out like a slot's outline, so the row of three read as full and two rows of floor were filed as slots. Read here with the header's estimate 12 px high (top_shift -12), as the live read had it: 0.10.53 reads 35 slots so.
